directive_basis: R404 item 10: current maturity -> next experiment -> expected information gain -> evidence required -> commercial state after PASS -> commercial state after FAIL. The bridge between scientific truth and technology transfer.

chain.current_maturity: ENGINEERING_DEFINED: CAD valid (0.07 mm diaphragm re-verified), bridge equation recorded, ZERO physical validation, the predecessor's measured kill channel (biofouling non-common-mode drift) restored to the canonical record but NOT repaired, no prior-art search artifact for THIS technology, lineage narrative in the frozen buyer dossier mis-attributed (LINEAGE_AUDIT.json)
chain.next_experiment: The paired-die drift benchmark (BENCHMARK_SPECIFICATION.json + DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT.json): identical single-ended baseline vs self-referencing treatment, same instrument, simultaneous acquisition — drift/thermal/hysteresis/cycling/aging/reference-stability/calibration-retention matrix PLUS the fouling-exposure arm that probes the predecessor's kill channel. PARALLEL cheap owner action: the fresh prior-art search
chain.expected_information_gain: Measures whether the architecture's ONE claim (drift advantage vs baseline) survives the predecessor's exact kill channel — i.e. whether self-referencing earns its proposition for THIS application; resolves the P-25 open boundary condition (can recalibration/anti-fouling hold error below threshold?) with direct measurement instead of a mitigation label
chain.evidence_required: Improvement RATIO (baseline drift / treatment drift) on the primary endpoint; the non-common-mode channels measured directly (biofouling arm, reference-element stability); pre-registered acceptance threshold with provenance (NOT P-25's cancelled numbers)
chain.commercial_state_after_PASS: The architecture's claim is earned with PHYSICAL_OBSERVATION evidence; a recalibration protocol can be designed on measured data; the evidence-repair items (search, lineage narrative) remain prerequisites for the buyer surface
chain.commercial_state_after_FAIL: Asymmetric fouling dominates (P-25's failure class replicated in the descendant) -> the self-referencing premise for THIS application is falsified: repair (non-common-mode compensation mechanism per KA-014/DC-P-25-001) or cemetery; the predecessor failure then correctly kills the descendant BY MEASUREMENT, not by inheritance (the directive's both-hands rule)
